samples.reason: The query is a support-dialogue tutoring request that requires extraction and synthesis of evidence from specified sources into a tightly constrained format (one paragraph answering two specific questions). Willet significantly outperforms Lapwing on the relevant capability dimensions—Support Dialogue (83.9 vs 78.9), Summarization (86.4 vs 80.6), Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 79.2), and instruction following (IFEval 89.8 vs 85.3)—making it the better choice for this task.

The query is a scoped extraction and summarization task that asks the model to synthesize provided sources into a single paragraph answering two specific historical questions. Willet-235B scores materially higher than Lapwing-235B on the relevant internal routing evals for Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs. 79.2) and Summarization (86.4 vs. 80.6), making it the stronger capability match.

This is a support-dialogue task requiring constrained generative synthesis (one paragraph combining source evidence and historical explanation). Willet outperforms Lapwing on Support Dialogue (83.9 vs. 78.9), Summarization (86.4 vs. 80.6), and instruction following (IFEval 89.8 vs. 85.3), and does not share Lapwing's self-reported aversion to open-ended generative work.

The query calls for extracting evidence from provided sources, synthesizing it into a concise historical explanation, and delivering it in a friendly, conversational tone. Willet substantially outperforms Lapwing on Extraction & Retrieval, Summarization, and Support Dialogue (each by more than 5 points), making it the stronger choice for this source-based synthesis task.

The query is a support-and-summarization task (history explanation in one paragraph using sources) where Willet outperforms Lapwing on all relevant internal evals by margins greater than 2.0 points: Support Dialogue (83.9 vs. 78.9), Summarization (86.4 vs. 80.6), and Creative Generation (84.7 vs. 82.7).
